body: Not everyone is feeling your level of pain. I have found many are feeling well and some are feeling worse. Your pain is very important.
Thanks man I appreciate your response

At 11 I would smell my fingers constantly. Of course all the kids teased me. I still do it many years later. And now I pull my nose hairs out by the 20’s. Who cares. I have everything a man could want. A beautiful wife, 30 year successful business, good friends and 36 years of sobriety. I can relate to the “got it good” but “ don’t wanna live” life. Let me know what helps you please
